pharmacology.text: THJ-018 acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 5.84 nM at CB1 and 4.57 nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: THJ-018 (SGT-17) is a synthetic cannabinoid that is the indazole analogue of JWH-018 and has been sold online as a designer drug.
